note: Common Paper publishes no key terms sheet for the Design Partner Agreement. These fields are the substitution points its Standard Terms already name; the labels and hints are ours.

fields.label: Term
fields.hint: How long the partnership runs. Both sides can agree to extend it, by email if they like.

fields.label: Program
fields.hint: What the partner actually does — early access, feedback on an agreed schedule, and what the provider is trying to learn.
fields.placeholder: Weekly feedback calls and access to pre-release builds of the analytics module

sections.title: Fees
sections.hint: Design partners often pay nothing; that is what this agreement is for.

fields.label: Fees
fields.hint: What the partner pays, if anything. Leave it empty if the programme is free.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.hint: Common practice, not legal advice: pick the state where one of you is incorporated.

fields.label: Governing law
fields.hint: The law that governs the agreement.

fields.label: Chosen courts
fields.placeholder: the state and federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware
